steps.name: Flick the dark grass

lines.text: Let the cow, its horns and its shaggy coat dry to the touch first. A hair dryer on low speeds it up.
Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is at the bottom edge, and its left side is at the left edge; it's about 11 1/2 in wide and 6 in tall.
The outline also reaches onto the green hills and meadow, and the highland cow, painted already: there, only soften this paint into their edge and leave them showing.
Paint: Deep green.
Brush: #6 fan. Load: A light load. Too much paint makes flat blobs.
A quick stroke upward from the base, lifting off as it goes, so each mark thins at the top.
It should leave tapered marks with broken tips, denser at the base.

steps.meant: Dark slanted grass marks cover the meadow and hide the cow's legs and lower body. There are no light green or gold grass marks yet.

steps.name: Flick the yellow-green grass

The outline also reaches onto the green hills and meadow, and the highland cow, painted already: there, only soften this paint into their edge and leave them showing.

Leave what step 16 painted showing around these marks, as in the Result picture.

steps.meant: The meadow is a mix of dark and yellow-green slanted marks, with the dark showing between them. There are no gold grass marks yet.

steps.name: Flick the golden grass
